t: G39 Jurisprudence Engine: Evidence Ledger — Simple
name: G39 Jurisprudence Engine: Evidence Ledger — Simple
title: G39 Jurisprudence Engine: Evidence Ledger — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Evidence with a hash chain: each item's hash includes the previous item's hash, so tampering anywhere breaks the chain everywhere after it. The ledger computes the tamper-detection odds — altering one item without detection requires a second preimage, and the odds are below.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Second-preimage odds per item (256-bit) = 4.318e-78 probability. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: The Perpetual Jurisprudence Engine (G39) – Quantifying the Jurisdictional Integrity Constant (JIC)
real_world_basis: Hash-chained ledgers are the real basis of digital evidence integrity.
signature_version: Signature version: the JIC ledger — the chapter's Jurisdictional Integrity Constant as the chain-strength target, with the perpetual framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: the hash function is the trust root — pick a standard one and never roll your own.
math_note: Second-preimage odds per item (256-bit): 4.318e-78 probability [verified]; Chain links for 5 items: 5 links [verified]

math_check.label: Chain links for 5 items
math_check.note: corrected 2026-10-19: formula was Fibonacci, unrelated to the claim

safety: Legal safety: the ledger preserves integrity; admissibility still needs counsel.
how_it_works: Hash each item with its predecessor's digest on intake, verify the chain on every access, and log the verification. The demo chains five items and verifies.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
